label: Homophobia
description: Depictions of anti-gay bigotry or discrimination.

label: Transphobia
description: Depictions of anti-trans bigotry or discrimination.

label: Biphobia
description: Depictions of anti-bisexual bigotry or erasure.

label: Conversion Therapy
description: Depictions of attempts to change someone's sexual orientation or gender identity.

label: Character Death
description: A queer character dies over the course of the story.

label: Sexual Violence
description: Depictions of sexual assault or coercion.

label: Addiction
description: Depictions of substance abuse or dependency.

label: Domestic Abuse
description: Depictions of abuse within a household or relationship.

label: Child Abuse
description: Depictions of abuse toward a minor.

label: Racism
description: Depictions of racial discrimination or bigotry.

label: Misgendering
description: A character is repeatedly referred to with the wrong gender.

label: Deadnaming
description: A trans or nonbinary character is referred to by a former name.
